targetText: With the exception of a few corrections in the text, the present edition does not differ from the previous one. I hope that, irrespective of the dispute with the Russian “Machians,” it will prove useful as an aid to an acquaintance with the philosophy of Marxism, dialectical materialism
explanation: Lenin emphasizes that the critique of empirio-criticism remains fully relevant for the international communist movement, serving as a systematic textbook on the philosophical foundations of dialectical materialism.
